description: Search the website postcode directory by postcode or English/Chinese locality name. Returns Delivery Area localities in postcode/name order, including multiple localities for the same postcode. Use get_postcode for regional classification and associated schools. This is not the course-campus postcode filter.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

query.description: Australian postcode, English locality or Chinese locality name. Preserve leading zeroes, e.g. "0800".

name: search_postcodes
title: Search Australian postcodes and localities
